title: Nourishing Chinese Lamb Congee
description: A traditional Chinese dish featuring lamb shoulder in a rich and comforting congee, with anti-inflammatory properties from ginger and turmeric.
instructions: Rinse the Chinese rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the sliced ginger until fragrant.
Add the lamb shoulder pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the turmeric, soy sauce, and 6 cups of water to the pot, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the lamb is tender.
Add the soaked and drained Chinese rice to the pot, stirring to combine.
Continue to simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the congee has reached the desired consistency.
Season with salt to taste, then serve the congee hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
